notes: The Library now sorts music into Classical and Modern. A switch at the top (All · Classical · Modern) that search, pieces, playlists, composers, favorites and recent all follow; long-press a piece or an artist to move it to the other side. Two new channels, Classical and Modern, play a whole genre without end, and schedules can use them. The web panel's library has the same switch, and the guests' request page gets it too, with a search box and your modern songs to ask for. Studio understands "modern" and "classical" in a typed idea. Every recording now gets its own cover, Recordings and Made in Studio show covers instead of letters, keeping a recording says "Kept in Recordings.", and nothing the tablet makes itself shows an import message any more.
